oracle_runtime.algorithm: Independent raw buyer customer-id set and Decimal revenue per customer over the complete customer registry; per-segment full-base cardinality, distinct any-line buyers including amount0, all-line revenue and full-base ratios; manual full3x6 independently checked, no Loginom outputs used.

dataset_origin.author: eval author
dataset_origin.description: Original synthetic six-customer complete base and five sales lines prepared under approved P09 fixture plan and frozen before manual gold/oracle; raw multiple invoices/lines per customer, nonbuyers, a zero-amount sale and a segment without sales, no precomputed answer columns.
dataset_origin.limitations: Not UCI, real CRM or a derived real-client snapshot. One monetary unit without tax or unagreed charges. Whole sales file scope is February2026 [2026-02-01,2026-03-01), civil calendar without timestamps or time conversion. Unique customer_id and line_id; invoice determines customer, valid customer foreign keys, case-sensitive ASCII keys, all cells nonempty/no NULL, nonnegative two-decimal amounts.

publication_note: Local machine paths, instance addresses and session/storage identifiers are omitted. Verification statements describe the original run; private evidence is not included. Public datasets, versions and content hashes are retained.
